two CVS PPO and lunar lander, reinforce VS two CVS PPO. In brief, PPO solved cartpole on every seed
with a stable curve, in a median of 38.7 k steps, and was the only method to solve lunar

policy but oscillated during training. On lunar lander it reached 108 plus or minus 61.

seed-sensitive. Reading, Sutton and Bartow, CH13, Shulman ETAL, Proximal Policy Optimization
